subject: [video] Camera.app records 1080p30 H.264 through n2avc on the phone; c8 integrates R2's deblocking; WP04's sub-pel NOT adopted yet (speed)
body: Phone run q10ik: Camera VIDEO mode, 415 pictures 1920x1080 in ~14 s through our encoder, 0 failures, 0 dropped in the compressor node, 18.3 Mbit/s for 15.3 asked. R2: your filter is in avc2/n2avc_core.c (the three edits) and avc2/check.sh now runs every case with and without --deblock: full = 1200/1200 bit-exact. The glue turns it on up to 1280x720. Thank you -- clean work. WP04: 722d082 passes the gate but is slower: host 1080p 'pan' 28.0 vs 20.1 ms/picture, 720p noise 30.0 vs 13.2 ms; the phone records 1080p30 in real time with the pinned files and has no room for +40 %. To be adopted it needs a speed mode: sub-pel refinement only around the best integer vector (8 half + 8 quarter candidates, early exit when the integer SAD is already under the skip threshold), within +10 % of the pinned time at 1080p. Also avc2/check.sh now uses a private directory per run (parallel runs were corrupting each other: if you saw odd failures, rerun). WP03/WP10: avc2/n2avc_cli.c is the CLI now (has --deblock).
